newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium falls on LME, firmer yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium falls on LME, firmer yen.

text.p: The Tokyo aluminium futures market closed lower across the board on Friday, reflecting price falls on the London Metal Exchange overnight and the yen's firmer sentiment, traders said.
Prices were 0.4 to 1.2 yen a kg lower, with the benchmark February 1998 contract down 0.9 yen at 208.1. The day's volume was 4,602 lots.

Light selling from individual investors emerged from the opening, traders said. Bearish sentiment has dogged the contract throughout the week, after the market plunged on Monday -- the first trading day, they said.
"LME prices and the yen/dollar rate will remain the market factor next week," a brokerage house trader said.
Trading volume reached 19,645 lots on Monday, but fell to 8,290 on Tuesday, 5,334 on Wednesday and 8,897 on Thursday. Open interest as of April 10 was 18,704 lots.
